description.value: Block 18 Cart Noodle is a Richmond restaurant specializing in Hong Kong-style cart noodles (車仔麵), where diners customize their bowl with a choice of broth, noodles, and toppings. The shop carries an authentic Cantonese identity, billing itself as 'traditional + creative' Hong Kong street food. In addition to dine-in and takeout meals, the restaurant sells a curated range of imported Hong Kong condiments and sauces online.
